words.meaning: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation for and to return kindness.
words.sentence1: She expressed deep gratitude for all the help she received during her recovery (She expressed deep gratitude for all the help she received during her recovery).
words.sentence2: A sense of gratitude filled his heart as he looked at his supportive family (A sense of gratitude filled his heart as he looked at his supportive family).

words.meaning: Intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
words.sentence1: El nino recibio el regalo con mucho entusiasmo (The boy received the gift with much enthusiasm).
words.sentence2: Su entusiasmo por el nuevo proyecto contagio a todo el equipo (His enthusiasm for the new project infected the whole team).

words.sentence1: Il regardait sa fille avec beaucoup de tendresse (He looked at his daughter with a lot of tenderness).
words.sentence2: Ce geste plein de tendresse toucha profondement son coeur (This gesture full of tenderness deeply touched her heart).

words.meaning: A state of happiness and satisfaction.
words.sentence1: Er blickte mit tiefem Gefühl der Zufriedenheit auf seine geleistete Arbeit zurück (He looked back at his accomplished work with a deep feeling of satisfaction).
words.sentence2: Innere Zufriedenheit ist oft wichtiger als Reichtum (Inner contentment is often more important than wealth).

words.sentence1: Kare wa shien-sha-tachi ni fukai kansha o hyōshita (He expressed deep gratitude to the supporters).
words.sentence2: Mainichi no kurashi ni kansha suru koto ga taisetsu da (It is important to be grateful for everyday life).

words.meaning: The feeling of being grateful or thankful.

words.sentence2: Le sue parole esprimevano sincera gratitudine (His words expressed sincere gratitude).

words.sentence1: Wǒmen yīnggāi duì shēnghuó zhōng de měi yí gè bāngzhù wǒmen de rén gǎn'ēn (We should be grateful to everyone in life who helps us).
words.sentence2: Tā hěn gǎn'ēn neng yǒu zhèyī cì jīhuì (He is very grateful to have this opportunity).

words.sentence1: Doeji anneun doum-e daehae jinshim-euro gamsa-reul deurimnida (I sincerely express my gratitude for your invaluable help).
words.sentence2: Geunyeo-neun maseissneun eumshik-e gamsa-haessda (She was thankful for the delicious food).

words.meaning: A sense of inner merit, wholesome emotion, or spiritual gladness.

words.meaning: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation.
